name: claudin
description: Claude internals with live docs: six authless docs MCP servers (Claude Code, claude.ai, Claude Platform API, Model Context Protocol, OpenAI and xAI developer docs) plus skill-creator-v2 (skill lifecycle: create, eval, benchmark, package, claude.ai compat), plugin-dev (plugins across chat, Cowork, Claude Code, Codex/ChatGPT, Grok Build, Copilot CLI, Antigravity and Gemini CLI) and mcp-dev (MCP servers, MCP Apps, OAuth, MCPB, directory review, spec 2026-07-28).

interface.longDescription: skill-creator-v2 runs the skill lifecycle: create, eval, benchmark, tune triggers, audit claude.ai compatibility and package. plugin-dev packages skills, MCP servers and Claude Code extras into plugins that load in Claude chat, Cowork, Claude Code, Codex/ChatGPT, Grok Build, GitHub Copilot CLI, Google Antigravity and Gemini CLI, with a per-surface component matrix and Claude-to-OpenAI conversion rules. mcp-dev designs, tests and ships MCP servers and MCP Apps: deployment choice, tool design, OAuth, MCPB, directory review and the stateless 2026-07-28 spec, with a stdlib probe script. Six docs MCP servers keep answers current. Personal toolkit maintained by travnie; not an official Anthropic, OpenAI or xAI plugin.
